notes: DRAFT for Ethereum mainnet (chain 1); not submitted. TODO before import: TODO_START = the unix time anyone may seed (the owner may seed earlier); $owner to be chosen (a fresh wallet; the owner cannot play seasons). The code is Sepolia test run 5's (branch testnet5): run 4's deployed code (launch #1466) plus the fix round (appeal floor raise, launch-owner exclusion, the appeal question with the real score and need, rules v3) and Objection! (src/Tribunal.sol, spec OBJECTIONS.md), with the run-5 numbers: split 82/6/12, six seasons of 10,000,000 PLEA bonus, top 25 paid from 450 down to 350 basis points. The factory deploys PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one transaction: 13.1M gas measured as the chain charges it, 16.0M with a 22% gas-limit headroom, under Ethereum's 16,777,216 per-transaction cap (test/LaunchManifest.t.sol asserts it). Constructor arguments: PLEA(owner = $owner). CabalGate(PLEA, Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, oracle fee asset = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, pool IMD (same), oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, season 1296000 s = 15 days, dead-man 118800 s). Seasons(PLEA, CabalGate, IMD). PleaDistributor(PLEA, owner = $owner). PleaLaunch(PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, IMD, imd/acc's mainnet Stacker 0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0 (launch #1409), credit gas 400000, START, the Letterbox's oracle fee asset = IMD, mintOracleFee = false (the Letterbox buys the 0.5 IMD oracle fee with the writer's PLEA together with the tip), the keccak256 of the Letterbox's creation code, and the keccak256 of the Tribunal's creation code (a zero hash would launch with objections off; the user decides after the Sepolia test run)). After the launch, anyone calls PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox(creationCode) once (about 5.4M gas, its own transaction) and PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode) once (about 4.8M), then PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) with a salt mined off chain; PLEA.init mints 82% to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor (the swarm's 10% and a 2% airdrop, one Merkle root set once by the owner); seed() opens trading (owner any time, anyone from START). Objection!: for 20 minutes after an approval anyone but the seller and the excluded owners may object through the Tribunal (0.5 IMD oracle fee and a 0.35 IMD stake, both in IMD on mainnet); a fresh panel re-scores the plea; the recorded score becomes the lowest any panel gave, sustained (no points, stake back) when the new score is more than 2 below the need, otherwise the stake goes to the season pot; at most two rulings per plea from different wallets; the sale is never touched.
